mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id
SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.code

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.major_id, u.class_id, u.cohort, u.enabled, r.id role_id, r.code role_code, r.name role_name, m.name major_name, c.name class_name FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = u.major_id LEFT JOIN school_class c ON c.id = u.class_id ORDER BY u.id
SELECT u.id, u.name FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.code = 'TEACHER' AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY u.id

SELECT g.*, u.name student_name, t.name teacher_name FROM guidance_record g JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = g.student_id JOIN sys_user t ON t.id = g.teacher_id WHERE
1=1 g.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=g.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
ORDER BY g.guidance_at DESC

SELECT d.*, u.name student_name, t.title topic_title, g.name group_name, g.teacher_ids, g.location, g.defense_at FROM defense_info d JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.student_id JOIN student_assignment a ON a.student_id = d.student_id JOIN topic_info t ON t.id = a.topic_id JOIN defense_group g ON g.id = d.group_id WHERE
1=1 d.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=d.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
ORDER BY g.defense_at, d.id

SELECT g.* FROM defense_group g WHERE
1=1
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM defense_info d WHERE d.group_id=g.id AND
1=1 d.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=d.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
)
ORDER BY g.defense_at

SELECT s.*, u.name student_name, t.name teacher_name FROM score_info s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.student_id JOIN sys_user t ON t.id = s.teacher_id WHERE
1=1 s.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=s.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
AND s.published=1 ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT a.*, u.name student_name, u.cohort, t.title topic_title FROM archive_record a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.student_id JOIN student_assignment sa ON sa.student_id = a.student_id JOIN topic_info t ON t.id = sa.topic_id WHERE
1=1 a.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=a.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT r.*, u.name reviewer_name, s.name student_name FROM review_record r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user s ON s.id = r.student_id WHERE
1=1
r.reviewer_id=#{scope.userId} OR (r.student_id IS NOT NULL AND
1=1 r.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=r.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
)
ORDER BY r.id DESC
SELECT l.*, u.name user_name FROM sys_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT n.*, u.name publisher_name FROM notice n JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.publisher_id ORDER BY n.id DESC
SELECT u.name FROM topic_selection s JOIN topic_info t ON t.id = s.topic_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.student_id WHERE s.status = '待审核' AND t.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT m.*, u.name student_name, teacher.name teacher_name, f.original_name FROM task_book m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.student_id JOIN sys_user teacher ON teacher.id = m.teacher_id JOIN file_record f ON f.id = m.file_id WHERE m.stage = #{stage} AND
1=1 m.student_id=#{scope.userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_assignment scoped WHERE scoped.student_id=m.student_id AND scoped.teacher_id=#{scope.userId})
ORDER BY m.student_id, m.version DESC
